summary: freeze X -> X, for an X that can be poison, refuted at X = poison
why: LLVM's src returns some value for a poison X and tgt returns poison. The model agrees, and tests/freeze/FreezeModel.lean proves it doesn't refine, as freeze_removed_wrong. The claim says some way src chooses allows tgt, which Lean can't decide at a witness, so tools/verify.py finds no counterexample.
